physical presence in our community. The region should work with
the college, municipalities, and other property owners to identify buildings
or spaces that could be adapted for transitional, supportive or
affordable housing where suitable. This would require an inventory of
available properties and assessment of renovation and operating costs and
partnerships with qualified housing providers. We should determine what existing
space can realistically be brought into use. How quickly it
can be done and how it could help address local
housing needs. We should explore opportunities and how it could
help address local housing needs. We should explore opportunities before
assuming that every new housing solution must begin with new
construction. Fourth, address homelessness and addiction together with practical, compassionate

people struggling with substance use disorders. And the impact addiction

safely or effectively met in a particular transitional housing setting.
